<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary legislative agenda:</strong> Union Home Minister Amit Shah intervened in Lok Sabha discussions regarding the Delimitation Bill 2026, the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, and the Union Territories Laws (Amendment) Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
